action.description: Which A/B testing action to run.

question.description: The question to ask the user

options.description: Optional list of choices for the user to select from

default.description: Default answer if user doesn't respond

work_object_id.description: WorkObject to track this event against.

metrics.description: Metric definitions with names, SQL, and chart types.

output_path.description: Optional file path to write the generated spec.

file_path.description: Path to the data file (CSV, Parquet, Excel, JSON)

file_type.description: Type of data source. Auto-detected from extension if omitted.

sample_rows.description: Number of rows to include in the head preview

nrows.description: Maximum number of rows to load. Omit to load all.

sample_size.description: Number of rows to sample for large datasets

fqtns.description: Fully qualified table names to evaluate.

allow_untrusted.description: When true, downgrade missing/untrusted tables to warnings.

code.description: Python code to execute. DATA_PATH is injected automatically.

data_path.description: Dataset path exposed to the code as DATA_PATH.

reference_data.description: Reference data as a list of records.

current_data.description: Current data as a list of records.

features.description: Optional subset of features to check.

code.description: Python code for evaluation. Should load model and test data, compute metrics, generate plots.

model_path.description: Path to the trained model file

code.description: Python code for feature engineering. Should load data, create features, save results.

output_path.description: Path to save the engineered feature matrix

code.description: Python code to generate deployment artifacts.

model_path.description: Path to the trained model file

code.description: Python code to generate the report.

project_dir.description: Path to the project directory containing artifacts

output_path.description: Path to save the generated report file

audience.description: Optional audience hint exposed to the report generation code.

action.description: Whether to capture a decision memo or trace a record.

record_id.description: Existing lineage record id for trace action.

parent_id.description: Optional parent lineage id for decision action.

session_id.description: Optional session id to associate with the decision.

pack_dir.description: Workspace-relative or absolute path to a semantic pack root.

skill_name.description: Built-in semantic pack skill directory name to load.

dry_run.description: When true, only return the diff without writing metrics.

allow_definition_updates.description: Allow metric definition changes to overwrite existing metrics.

query.description: Business term, acronym, or phrase to look up.

limit.description: Maximum number of glossary matches to return.

key.description: Short identifier key (e.g., 'churn_definition'). Same key+type will update existing entry.

code_blocks.description: Ordered code cells to include in the notebook.

descriptions.description: Markdown cells to include before the code cells.

outputs.description: Optional stdout output for each code cell.

action.description: Action or tool name to evaluate.

confidence.description: Confidence score used for deployment-style approvals.

record_approval.description: Whether to record an explicit approval for standing approval tracking.

file_path.description: Path to the file to read

head_lines.description: Only return first N lines. Omit to read all.

analysis.description: Structured analysis payload keyed by section name.

output_dir.description: Directory where the rendered file should be written.

pack_context.description: Optional DeliveryPack-level metadata such as pack_id and confidence.

code.description: Python code for EDA. Use pandas, matplotlib/seaborn. Save plots with plt.savefig().

data_path.description: Path to the dataset file to analyze

artifacts.description: Verifier inputs. May include semantic_candidates for verified query / glossary / trust write-back proposals.

limit.description: Sample row limit for sample action (max 100).

query.description: Search query. Use '*' to list most recent session entries.

session_id.description: Optional session ID to restrict results to.

question.description: Business question or KPI request to resolve semantically.

required_grain.description: Optional grain constraint for metric matching.

as_of_date.description: Optional ISO date for calendar hints and query binding.

dialect.description: Preferred SQL dialect for verified queries.

allow_untrusted.description: Allow bronze/untrusted tables with warnings instead of blocking.

work_object_id.description: WorkObject to track this email against.

webhook_url.description: Optional webhook URL; defaults to DS_AGENT_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL.

sections.description: Ordered slide sections with title and bullets.

audience.description: Audience hint used in output metadata.

output_path.description: Optional file path to write the markdown slide spec.

estimated_cost_usd.description: Internal hook-populated cost estimate for the query.

prompt.description: Prompt executed when the order fires.

trigger.description: Trigger spec. Cron example: {'type': 'cron', 'cron': '0 9 * * MON', 'timezone': 'Asia/Seoul'}. Event example: {'type': 'event', 'event_type': 'file.created', 'filters': {'path_suffix': '.csv'}}.

approval_gate.description: How results should be handled after execution.

budget_limit_usd.description: Per-run budget cap for the standing order.

code.description: Python code for model training. Should load data, train model, evaluate, and save.

data_path.description: Path to the feature matrix file

target_column.description: Name of the target variable column

model_output_path.description: Path to save the trained model file

timeout.description: Maximum execution time in seconds (default 15 min)

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return

file_path.description: Path to the file to write

content.description: Content to write to the file
